Ayaka is a character from the game Genshin Impact below is everything about Ayaka (In the game)
Description:
She is the youngest daughter of the Kamisato Clan and sister of Kamisato Ayato. Being beautiful, elegant, and graceful, the common people have nothing to say bad about Kamisato Ayaka. Due to her social status as the youngest daughter of the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission and as the Heron Princess, Kamisato Ayaka is seen as a model of perfection.

Appearance
Kamisato Ayaka is a girl of slightly below average height. She keeps her long blue-white hair tied into a high ponytail with an armored headdress. Her bangs are cut straight, with two front strands of her hair on the sides separated by 3-petal pink flower knots. Her light blue-gray eyes are accompanied by thick eyelashes and a mole under her left eye.

She wears a silver royal blue skirt with a variety of patterns down to her knees, with gold accents and small white flower patterns. She has a black breastplate with a gold shield in the center and matching armor plates on the sides of her skirt. Under her breastplate is a loose elbow-length shirt with gradients from blue to white. Her cuffs and collar on top are navy blue with a variety of gold stripes. She wears black sleeves under the loose shirt that hangs over her middle fingers and covers both thumbs. Above her black sleeves are white armored plating lined with gold metal, held together by red knots.

On the back of her outfit is a large purple bow, tied by her Vision and another pink flower knot. The bottom half of the ribbons are obscured with gold markings seemingly native to her homeland.

She wears black geta sandals with white ankle-length socks decorated with pink bows on the back. As an accessory, she carries a gold-navy fan matching her skirt.

Personality
Kamisato Ayaka is a kind-hearted girl with a pleasant temperament who treats others with courtesy and kindness. She cherishes the people of Inazuma in her heart and often goes out of her way to personally help them in all sorts of matters. She is a perfectionist with a serious personality. People are often touched by her dedication, and she was given the honorary title of "Princess Heron" by those close to her. People in the neighborhood always speak of her with sincere admiration.

She is well-liked and very popular in Inazuma, but she doesn't have good social skills to make friends with anyone. People in her hometown want to get close to her and befriend her, but unfortunately they think too much that they wouldn't fit in with Kamisato Ayaka's elegant presence and that their conversation wouldn't go well.

Thanks to the influence of Kamisato Ayaka's excellent upbringing, her heart is as pure as crystallized ice. Just like the splendid colors reflected when ice crystals spin in the winter air, so is the spirit of Kamisato Ayaka. She not only possesses great outer beauty and graceful demeanor, but also, not known to many, has a tender and cute side.

But if you want to capture a heart that hangs high in the sky, you must have the ability to climb the clouds. In other words, Kamisato Ayaka is eager to associate with people capable of accomplishing great deeds; in her eyes, friendships are dictated by fate, just as she was destined to wield her frost-covered sword.
